texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Secretary of the Treasury shall deliver to the  Secretary  of  Health  and  Human  Services, upon his request, samples of food, drugs, devices, tobacco products, and cosmetics which are being imported  or  offered  for  import  into  the  United States,  giving  notice  thereof  to  the  owner  or consignee, who may appear before the Secretary of  Health  and  Human  Services  and  have  the right  to  introduce  testimony.
